lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all change types (adoption redesign, choose_path copy, finish notification, home wait_info, sign_in reorder) since each has only one test.
No clear effect was seen across any of the tested changes, as no test achieved a statistically significant result.
Predictions were generally too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Showcase Stage
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a stage layout with pet choice cards showcasing distinct personalities.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s; a stage layout with distinct visual personality choices helps users choose faster.

guard.reason: Redesigns the friend selection screen while preserving the ability to choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adoption redesign showed negative lift in prior tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls and Interaction Guide
candidates.change: Adds a new guidance screen after home_intro explaining how to control, summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, plus desktop feature misbehavior after setup.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click for options. Use system tray to hide or call back your companion.

guard.reason: Adds a new controls guide screen after home_intro, which is permitted by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mail and funnel, but adding a new screen increases friction and cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Hatching Warmup Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive hatching warmup screen right before the waiting screen to keep users entertained while pet assets finish generating.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; interactive visual feedback reduces drop-offs during preparation.

new_hatching_warmup.headline: Preparing Your Pet's New Home
new_hatching_warmup.body: Tap to interact while your desktop companion finishes hatching!

guard.reason: _order leaves out existing screens ['home_intro']: no step may be removed

candidates.title: Cloud Account Persistence Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a focused card layout highlighting automatic cloud backup for saved pet states.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again; framing sign-in around data protection builds confidence.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in so your pet companion and custom settings are safely saved across restarts and updates.
sign_in.hint: Your pet state is permanently linked to your account credentials.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Persistent Session Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit hint explaining how account login protects pet customization and stats across launches.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets resetting after sign-in, indicating confusion around account sync.

sign_in.hint: Use the same login email to keep your adopted pet, stats, and custom items synced safely.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Companion Care Tips During Setup Wait
candidates.change: Displays a tip carousel component on the waiting screen featuring companion care tips and shortcuts.
candidates.why: Home wait median time is 201s; providing engaging tips reduces perceived wait time and prepares users for post-onboarding interactions.

components.text: Quick Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime for care options.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with care tips while maintaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Target step has good conversion, and wait_info changes previously produced negative lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Value Headline
candidates.change: Updates story screen headline and body text to clearly explain the benefits of having a desktop companion before choosing a path.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s; setting clear expectations early on the story screen helps users decide quickly.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Workspace Buddy
story.body: Choose your journey: adopt a pre-made companion or build a custom pet to keep you company while you work.

guard.reason: Updates story copy to introduce the desktop companion.

candidates.score_note: Cheap text-only change with a slightly positive prior test result.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Seal Badge
candidates.change: Adds a companion adoption seal badge to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing the pet choice.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%); adding a tangible completion seal strengthens motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations! Your desktop companion adoption is officially registered.

guard.reason: Replaces the required official stamp on the adoption certificate with a generic badge that does not read as an official stamp.

candidates.title: First-Time Desktop Summoning Hint
candidates.change: Adds a prominent hint on home_intro showing shortcut keys and tray controls for summoning the pet.
candidates.why: Users wrote to support asking how to control or bring back pets after onboarding finished.

home_intro.hint: Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Click the system tray icon to summon, hide, or manage your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop pet shortcut hint to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from support tickets and funnel with positive prior signal for finish hints.

candidates.title: Structured Photo Upload Guidance Layout
candidates.change: Changes upload_photos layout to split with a clear photo recommendation checklist component.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failures or bad results; clear upload guidance prevents poor input photos.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Companion Photos
upload_photos.hint: For best custom pet results, upload bright, forward-facing photos.

components.label: Upload Checklist: Front view, well-lit, clear background

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

picked: Companion Care Tips During Setup Wait

decisions.title: Companion Care Tips During Setup Wait

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish new_screen, finish notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 2 tests; despite leaning positive, neither test was statistically significant.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Predictions were overly optimistic in round 1, but underestimated measured outcomes in round 2 when predicting lower or negative gains.
